product_brief: Easy-to-install Internet security layer that automatically applies end-to-end post-quantum cryptography between computers running PQConnect.
pqc_support: Yes — automatically applies post-quantum cryptography end to end between computers running PQConnect
pqc_capability_description: PQConnect automatically applies post-quantum cryptography from end to end between computers running it. It adds cryptographic protection to unencrypted applications, adds post-quantum protection to existing pre-quantum applications, and adds a second application-independent defense layer. Specific algorithms are not named in this page. Latest release: 1.2.3.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Works with unmodified applications; clients automatically detect PQConnect-supporting servers and transparently encrypt traffic to them; sysadmins configure a server name to announce PQConnect support, described as easy.

evidence.PQC Support: PQConnect automatically applies post-quantum cryptography from end to end between computers running PQConnect.
